title: Prevalence of anaemia in women aged 15 to 49 years, by pregnancy status

national_indicator_available: Prevalence of anaemia in women aged 15 to 49 years, by pregnancy status
national_indicator_description: This indicator measures the percentage of women aged 15−49 years with a haemoglobin concentration less than 120 g/L for non- pregnant women and lactating women, and less than 110 g/L for pregnant women, adjusted for altitude and smoking.
computation_calculations: For more information about the methodology used to calculate the prevalence of anaemia in women aged 15 to 49 years, please see the linked data source.
other_info: This indicator is published by the World Bank based on figures from the Global Health Observatory Data Repository/World Health Statistics, World Health Organization (WHO).
